label: Bible Study
prompt: _____ thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
verse: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
note: Hand over the whole road, not just the next step — then trust him to bring it to pass.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain _____ by our Lord Jesus Christ,
verse: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,
note: God's appointment for us isn't wrath — it's salvation. Good news worth keeping on the calendar.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the soldiers _____ a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
verse: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
note: The KJV spells it 'platted' — the soldiers wove a crown of thorns and added a purple robe to mock the King.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in _____ for his soul?
verse: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
note: Jesus prices the whole world against one soul — then asks what anyone could possibly offer to buy it back.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Thou hast made us as the _____ and refuse in the midst of the people.
verse: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
note: Jerusalem made 'the offscouring and refuse' among nations — Paul uses the same word for the apostles in 1 Corinthians 4:13.
